LandingPage.label: Showcase home
LandingPage.check: Open the demo cards and check navigation at desktop and mobile widths.

CombinedListPage.label: Combined feature list
CombinedListPage.check: Toggle the park and café layers; select a list entry and check that the map and list stay in sync.

FullPage.label: Full UI
FullPage.check: Select a feature, open its details, and check the list and map at desktop and mobile widths.

SimpleMapPage.label: Simple map
SimpleMapPage.check: Pan and zoom the map; check the controls without the surrounding feature-list UI.

CustomPage.label: Custom overlays
CustomPage.check: Open the share-position and distance tools; switch between them and close them again.

RouterPage.label: Router integration
RouterPage.check: Switch between Home, Example 1 and Example 2, then use browser Back and Forward.

VectorWebglComparisonPage.label: Canvas / WebGL comparison
VectorWebglComparisonPage.check: Compare both renderers while selecting features and zooming the map.

EditorPage.label: Icon editor
EditorPage.check: Change the pictogram, label and colors; compare the preview with the marker on the map.

CatalogPage.label: Icon catalog
CatalogPage.check: Search for the changed icon or group; enable all variants and compare light and dark previews.

CountAggregatorDemoPage.label: Count aggregator wizard
CountAggregatorDemoPage.check: Search for Example, select a station, choose Next, then check the chart, table and CSV download.
CountAggregatorDemoPage.note: Count-aggregator demos use local mock data.

CountAggregatorHeadlessPage.label: Headless count aggregator
CountAggregatorHeadlessPage.check: Select a station and choose Load daily values; check the returned rows.
CountAggregatorHeadlessPage.note: Count-aggregator demos use local mock data.

ImprintPage.label: Imprint
ImprintPage.check: Read the legal details and follow the links.

PrivacyPage.label: Privacy
PrivacyPage.check: Read the privacy text and follow the links.

featureList.check: Navigate the feature list with Tab and arrow keys, select an entry, and check pagination and map selection at a narrow viewport.

search.check: Open search, type a place, and check loading, results, keyboard selection and closing the overlay. Search uses an external service.

layers.check: Toggle individual layers and groups; check keyboard focus, visible map features and the feature list.

mapTools.check: Open the distance and share-position tools, interact with the map, and switch tools. Check keyboard controls where enabled in this demo's configuration.

overlays.check: Open and close an overlay with the keyboard, press Escape, and check focus returns to its trigger; repeat at a mobile width.
